menu_item_call.label: Reference for the Word at the Caret
menu_item_call.name: reference

button.name: save_btn
button.tool_tip: Save and compile the script (Control+S); a notecard is saved as it is

button.name: save_all_btn
button.tool_tip: Save every script with unsaved changes (Control+Alt+S)

button.name: find_btn
button.tool_tip: Find in this script (Control+F); Control+Shift+F finds across scripts

button.name: format_btn
button.tool_tip: Put the script's indentation and spacing right (Shift+Alt+F)

button.name: expanded_btn
button.tool_tip: Show what the preprocessor made of this script, as the server compiles it, in place of the source; press again for the source. Read-only.

button.label: Explorer
button.name: fold_explorer
button.tool_tip: The objects in hand and their scripts, down the left (Control+Alt+0)

button.label: Lists
button.name: fold_bottom
button.tool_tip: The band under the editor: the problems, the references, what the scripts say, and search (Control+Alt+1, 2 and 3)

button.label: Inspector
button.name: fold_inspector
button.tool_tip: The outline and the symbol at the caret, down the right (Control+Alt+4)

scroll_list.name: explorer
scroll_list.tool_tip: The objects in hand -- pinned, selected in world, or holding a script that is open -- and their scripts and notecards; double-click to open one, right-click for everything else

scroll_list.columns.label: Name
scroll_list.columns.name: name
scroll_list.columns.tool_tip: The objects in hand, each prim of a linkset, and what each prim holds

scroll_list.columns.label: Type
scroll_list.columns.name: kind
scroll_list.columns.tool_tip: What each row is: an object, a prim, an LSL or Lua script, or a notecard

scroll_list.columns.label: State
scroll_list.columns.name: run
scroll_list.columns.tool_tip: Whether a script runs in its object

button.label: Open
button.name: explorer_open
button.tool_tip: Open the chosen scripts and notecards

button.label: Start
button.name: explorer_start
button.tool_tip: Set the chosen scripts running; every script of a chosen object or prim

button.label: Stop
button.name: explorer_stop
button.tool_tip: Stop the chosen scripts; every script of a chosen object or prim

button.label: Reset
button.name: explorer_reset
button.tool_tip: Reset the chosen scripts; every script of a chosen object or prim

tab_strip.name: tabs
tab_strip.tool_tip: The scripts open here, one tab each; the tab shown is the script being edited

jump_bar.name: breadcrumb
jump_bar.tool_tip: Where the caret is: the line and column at the right, and from the script down to the symbol around it at the left. Press a step to go there; press its arrow to pick one of the symbols beside it instead.

button.label: Reset
button.name: reset_btn
button.tool_tip: Reset the script in its object: its state forgotten and state_entry run again

check_box.label: Running
check_box.name: running
check_box.tool_tip: Whether the script runs in its object; a save keeps whatever this says

combo_box.name: compile_target
combo_box.tool_tip: What the script compiles for when it is saved: LSL on Mono (the usual choice), on the legacy LSL2 machine, or on Luau, or Lua itself. A script written in one language compiles for that language's targets only.

check_box.label: Errors
check_box.name: problems_errors
check_box.tool_tip: Show what stops the script from compiling or running

check_box.label: Warnings
check_box.name: problems_warnings
check_box.tool_tip: Show what probably does not do what was written

check_box.label: Notes
check_box.name: problems_notes
check_box.tool_tip: Show what is worth a look: the optimizer's changes, the lint's advice

combo_box.name: problems_origin
combo_box.tool_tip: Only what one source said: the checkers, the compiler, the preprocessor, the optimizer, the script as it ran

filter_editor.label: Filter
filter_editor.name: problems_filter
filter_editor.tool_tip: Only problems with these words in them

scroll_list.name: problems
scroll_list.tool_tip: What the compiler and the analyzers said; choosing one goes to its line

scroll_list.name: references
scroll_list.tool_tip: Every place the name last looked up stands, in this script and in the object's others; choosing one goes there

combo_box.name: output_filter
combo_box.tool_tip: Which object's scripts to listen to

button.label: Clear
button.name: output_clear
button.tool_tip: Forget what was said so far

button.label: Copy All
button.name: output_copy
button.tool_tip: Everything the pane shows, on the clipboard as it reads

output_view.name: output
output_view.placeholder: What the scripts say on the debug channel and to their owner appears here, as it is said.
output_view.tool_tip: What the scripts said on the debug channel and to their owner; a script's name is a link to it, at the line of a run-time error, and a URL in what was said is one too

scope_bar.name: search_bar
scope_bar.tool_tip: A search said as a sentence: the words, how they have to match, and where to look. Return runs it, and changing a word runs it again.

button.label: Replace All
button.name: search_replace
button.tool_tip: Every place found replaced by the words in the box, script by script, each script's own one step to undo. A script that is not open is opened with the change unsaved.

line_editor.name: search_replacement
line_editor.tool_tip: What to put in place of the words found

scroll_list.name: search_results
scroll_list.tool_tip: Every place the words were found; double-click one to open its script there

scroll_list.name: outline
scroll_list.tool_tip: What the script declares, in the order written; choosing one goes to it

text_view.name: symbol
text_view.tool_tip: The symbol at the caret: its declaration, its documentation and its page on the wiki; F1 asks for a word, and the Help menu browses the whole reference
